tools.name: delegate_tasks
tools.description: Delegate one to five bounded tasks to prepared specialists. Set specialist to a role ID. Normally omit pool so the coordinator uses pools.default_pool; set pool only to override it with an execution-pool ID. Read work runs concurrently and write work serially.

tasks.description: Bounded tasks assigned to prepared specialist roles. No registry lookup is needed for the usual case: omit pool to use pools.default_pool.

specialist.description: Required prepared specialist role ID, for example repository-scout. This is not a pool ID.

pool.description: Optional execution-pool ID from pools.json. Omit this field to use pools.default_pool; an accidentally blank value also uses that default. Do not copy the specialist ID here.

task.description: The bounded work for the selected specialist to complete.
